research_sources.supports: Nishi-Hotakaguchi Station is at 2,156 m; rooftop observation deck provides a 360-degree Northern Alps panorama including Mt Nishihotaka, Mt Yari and Mt Kasagatake; Itadaki no Mori provides additional outdoor viewpoints.

research_sources.authority: Shinhotaka Ropeway Official Seasonal View Guide
research_sources.supports: Four-season scenic value is official: spring snow/green contrast, summer greenery, autumn foliage typically peaking around mid-October with possible snow-capped peak contrast, and winter snow-covered Northern Alps.
Ropeway operates year-round but may suspend for adverse weather or scheduled maintenance; access to Nishi-Hotakaguchi depends on the No.1/No.2 ropeway operating path.

Night access to the rooftop observation deck and Itadaki no Mori is event-specific; 2026 autumn stargazing dates and 18:00-21:00 transport windows are officially published, so ordinary clear nights must not be treated as accessible.

MapFan places Nishi-Hotakaguchi Station at 36.2678409, 137.6017974; multiple geotagged photographs taken from the station area cluster around 36.2681-36.2683, 137.6016, supporting the rooftop/adjacent summit observation Camera Zone.
